story_description: Build the settings window foundation, navigation, categories, and search.
task_description: The settings detail panel needs to route from SettingsCategory enum to the appropriate SwiftUI view. A router provides centralized, type-safe navigation.
atom_description: The settings detail panel needs to route from SettingsCategory enum to the appropriate SwiftUI view. A router provides centralized, type-safe navigation.
problem_statement: The settings detail panel needs to route from SettingsCategory enum to the appropriate SwiftUI view. A router provides centralized, type-safe navigation.
scope_in: Map SettingsCategory to corresponding View; provide @ViewBuilder factory
Implement CategoryDetailRouter.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Must return valid View for all 12 cases
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
Default window size 1200 x 800 and resizable
Transparent titlebar with traffic lights visible
Background clear, isOpaque false, shadow enabled
functional_requirements: `view(for category: SettingsCategory) -> some View` - Return appropriate view
Use DSGlass styling for any settings panels or UI surfaces.
Persist user choices via the specified storage mechanism.
nonfunctional_requirements: View creation is instant (no heavy init)
Must not block the main UI thread.
implementation_steps: Return stub views for unimplemented categories
Review the CategoryDetailRouter.swift section in docs/settings-development.md and confirm required fields and flows.
Create or update the target Swift file and add missing imports.
event_contracts: Event contracts are defined through telemetry events for this atom.
No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_states: Default state renders with glass styling and current theme tokens.
Editing state reflects live changes as controls are adjusted.
Empty or error state renders fallback text and does not crash.
ui_interactions: User changes a control and the setting persists immediately.
User navigates between categories and the detail view updates.
User uses keyboard navigation to move focus between controls.
ui_copy: Section headers are localized and match the category name.
Control labels match the setting names listed in functional requirements.
edge_cases: New category added - compiler error until case added (by design)
Missing dependencies should fall back to safe defaults without crashing.
Invalid user input should be rejected with a clear message.
failure_modes: If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
If decoding fails, load defaults and continue.
rollback_plan: Inline switch in SettingsWindow; remove router file

unit: Verify all categories return non-crashing views
Unit test core logic for CategoryDetailRouter.swift with representative inputs.
integration: Integration test CategoryDetailRouter.swift with dependent stores or managers.
Verify persistence round trips when settings are updated.
ui: Verify SwiftUI previews render without crash.
perf: Ensure settings changes apply without visible jank.
security: Ensure no sensitive data is logged.
Verify file permissions for any on-disk artifacts.
